title: Neighbor Small Talk
setting: Friendly conversation with neighbors in Costa Rica
userGoal: Build rapport and handle short everyday exchanges without sounding stiff.
starterPrompts: Estamos aprendiendo espanol porque queremos vivir aqui.
culturalNotes: Warmth matters as much as grammar in social exchanges.
Short follow-up questions usually feel more natural than long explanations.
It helps when both partners take turns and ask something back.
likelyMisunderstandings: The learner may sound too formal for a casual neighborhood chat.
The learner may talk too long and forget to ask a return question.
The neighbor may mention the area, weather, or family quickly in passing.

variants.title: Front gate hello
variants.setup: You meet a neighbor by the gate while carrying groceries.
variants.localReplyStyle: The neighbor is friendly and expects a warm greeting first.
variants.pressureNote: A simple return question is enough to keep the conversation going.
variants.starterPrompt: Mucho gusto, somos nuevos por aqui.

variants.title: Walk and chat
variants.setup: You are chatting briefly while walking down the street.
variants.localReplyStyle: The neighbor may comment on the weather, the barrio, or local routines.
variants.pressureNote: Listen for small local references that you can echo back.

variants.title: Coffee invitation
variants.setup: A neighbor is inviting you to stop by for coffee or a quick chat.
variants.localReplyStyle: The neighbor sounds warm and open, with one invitation and one follow-up question.
variants.pressureNote: A short and friendly answer is better than a long explanation.
variants.starterPrompt: Que dicha. Gracias por la invitacion.

turns.title: Open warmly
turns.learnerGoal: Say hello and mention that you are new to the area.
turns.prompt: Buenos dias. Ustedes son nuevos por aqui?
turns.repairCue: If the learner sounds formal, coach them toward a warm, relaxed greeting.

branchOptions.label: Say where you are from
branchOptions.prompt: Si, somos de Estados Unidos y estamos aprendiendo espanol.

turns.title: Ask a return question
turns.learnerGoal: Keep the exchange going by asking one friendly question back.
turns.prompt: Que bueno. De donde son ustedes?
turns.repairCue: If the learner only answers and stops, ask them to add one question back.

branchOptions.label: Answer and ask back
branchOptions.prompt: Somos de Estados Unidos. Y ustedes, viven aqui hace mucho?

branchOptions.label: Ask about the area
branchOptions.prompt: Nos gusta mucho el barrio. Tiene una soda cerca?

turns.title: Close naturally
turns.learnerGoal: End the chat with warmth and an invitation or thanks.
turns.prompt: Que dicha. Cualquier cosa me avisan.
turns.repairCue: If the learner only says goodbye, ask them to add thanks or a simple invitation.

branchOptions.label: Return the invitation
branchOptions.prompt: Gracias. Tambien pueden pasar a tomar cafe un dia.

followUpDrills.title: Say hello warmly
followUpDrills.goal: Practice a short, friendly neighborhood greeting.
followUpDrills.prompt: Mucho gusto, somos nuevos por aqui.

followUpDrills.title: Compare casual and stiff phrasing
followUpDrills.goal: Practice a friendlier version of the same introduction.
followUpDrills.prompt: Mucho gusto, somos nuevos por aqui. / Hola, que gusto saludarlos.
steps: Notice which one feels more natural.

followUpDrills.title: Shadow a friendly neighbor line
followUpDrills.goal: Repeat a warm local reply at natural speed.
followUpDrills.prompt: Que dicha. Cualquier cosa me avisan.
steps: Repeat it again with the same tone.

followUpDrills.title: Dictate the small talk line
followUpDrills.goal: Write the warm response you hear and read it back.
followUpDrills.prompt: Que dicha. Cualquier cosa me avisan.

followUpDrills.title: Split the greeting
followUpDrills.goal: Let one partner greet and the other ask a return question.
followUpDrills.prompt: Partner A says hello and says you are new. Partner B asks one friendly question back.
steps: Partner B asks where the neighbor is from.

coupleSupport.sharedGoal: One partner opens the conversation and the other keeps it going with a friendly follow-up question.
partnerRoles: Partner A greets and says you are new
Partner B asks a friendly return question
handoffPrompts: Ahora tu pareja hace la pregunta de regreso.
Tu turno: responde con una frase corta y amable.
coupleSupport.keepBothInvolvedTip: Short, warm turns feel more natural here than perfect grammar or long explanations.

listeningCues.focus: friendly small talk and turn handoffs
listeningCues.previewLine: Que dicha. Cualquier cosa me avisan.
